title: Sport in Britain and the USA (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Odpowiedz na pytania (1.1.-1.5.) dotyczace wiedzy o krajach anglojezycznych. Odpowiadaj po angielsku. W pytaniach oznaczonych 2 pkt nalezy podac dwie informacje.

items.question: In which London stadium is the FA Cup Final played?
What is the name of the oldest tennis tournament in the world?
What is the name of the annual American football championship game? In which month is it usually played?
Which sport is played at Lord's in London?
What is the name of the annual rowing race held on the Thames between the universities of Oxford and Cambridge?
